tasks.title: Add scene-run columns and the published-dialogue tables to D1
tasks.dod: `0005_film_dialogues.sql` adds the two `story_runs` columns and the three dialogue tables, applies on the `npm test` SQLite D1 stand-in, existing story runs read as `kind = 'story'`, and the down file reverts it.

tasks.title: Return where each word appears from the word check, and pin the rule with a shared case file
tasks.dod: `matchPlaces` returns the expected ranges for every case in `match-cases.json`, and the existing story word-check tests still pass.

tasks.title: Ask for dialogues in the subtitle prompt and check them in the reply
tasks.dod: With `dialogues: false` the request equals a snapshot of today's `buildSubtitleRequest`, and `checkDialogues` drops exactly the AC-04/AC-05 cases in the tests.

tasks.title: Accept the dialogues flag on POST /subtitles/words and return the checked dialogues
tasks.dod: Through the Anthropic stub: with the flag, the reply carries checked dialogues; without it, the response is today's; a cut-off reply with dialogues answers `words_not_picked`.

tasks.title: Run scene pictures as two-step runs of the story run workflow
tasks.dod: A scene run records a prompt step and a picture step and no story step, takes one allowance unit at start and one per Draw again, and keeps the speech-bubble lines verbatim in the stored prompt.

tasks.title: Store dialogues with a published session and carry them in publish and republish
tasks.dod: Publishing with dialogues stores them linked to the right rows; republishing replaces them; publishing without them is unchanged.

tasks.title: Add the append route and the scene-picture upload route for a published session
tasks.dod: An append adds rows and dialogues once per import id without touching existing rows; a picture upload makes the picture readable by its public link; wrong token and expired link are refused.

tasks.title: Carry dialogues and scene-picture arrivals in the shared page's change feed
tasks.dod: After a partner edits a dialogue word's translation, deletes its row, or edits its word so it no longer appears, the next feed answer carries that dialogue in its new state.

tasks.title: Render the dialogue pages after the word table on the shared page
tasks.dod: A published session with dialogues renders one dialogue page each, in order, with correct bold places and the arrived picture; one without dialogues renders byte for byte as before.

tasks.title: Keep the shared page's dialogue pages in step with the change feed
tasks.dod: With the page open, a dialogue appended by the app, a picture arriving, and a partner's translation edit or row delete each show on the dialogue page after one poll.

tasks.title: Add "Dialogs from movie" to the exercise list for the app and the web
tasks.dod: Both lists hold twelve exercises in the same order, and the web learn page's Start with "Dialogs from movie" ticked opens coming soon.

tasks.title: Add FilmDialogue, Session.dialogues, WordGroup.dialogueId and StoryRun kind to the app
tasks.dod: The new fields round-trip through Isar and JSON, and an Isar store written before this change opens with empty dialogues and story-kind runs.

tasks.title: Port the matching rule to Dart and test it against the Worker's case file
tasks.dod: Every case in `match-cases.json` gives the same places in Dart as in TypeScript.

tasks.title: Add the Done filter, the edit rule and the card names for dialogues
tasks.dod: The AC-03, AC-11, AC-13 and AC-26 examples from the spec pass as unit tests, including a pending dialogue that becomes hidden instead of removed.

tasks.title: Group dialogue words into dialogue groups before the existing grouping rules
tasks.dod: The AC-06, AC-15, AC-17, AC-24 and AC-25 examples pass as unit tests, and every existing grouping test still passes.

tasks.title: Add the "Get dialogues from subtitles" switch to Settings
tasks.dod: The switch shows off on first launch, keeps its value across restarts, and the provider reflects it.

tasks.title: Carry dialogues from the subtitle import to Done and save them with the words
tasks.dod: With the setting off the request has no `dialogues` key and Done adds only words; with it on Done saves words and filtered dialogues in one session save; a changed session drops both.

tasks.title: Apply the edit rule to dialogues whenever a word changes or is deleted
tasks.dod: Deleting a dialogue word, editing it out of the text, editing its translation, and deleting every word of a dialogue each leave the session in the AC-11/AC-26 state after one save.

tasks.title: Show the main screen as a pager with one read-only dialogue page per dialogue
tasks.dod: A session without dialogues renders exactly as before with no pager; one with dialogues pages through them with correct bold words and lists, and follows edits.

tasks.title: Start, follow and collect scene runs in the app, and show them in Story runs
tasks.dod: A scene run started by the tracker is collected into Isar with its two steps and picture, sets the dialogue's scene picture, and appears in Story runs as a two-step run.

tasks.title: Offer "Dialogs from movie" on the learn page with dialogue groups
tasks.dod: In a session with dialogues the learn page shows the dialogue cards and the line, starts nothing on selection, and Start routes per AC-13; without dialogues the exercise is greyed and everything else is unchanged.

tasks.title: Add the dialogue screen with its scene picture and open it from Start
tasks.dod: Start on a dialogue group without a picture starts one scene run and shows its progress and outcome; reopening shows the picture with no Worker call.

tasks.title: Send the session's dialogues and scene-picture declarations when publishing
tasks.dod: A publish of a session with dialogues sends them with correct entry positions; without dialogues the body is unchanged.

tasks.title: Append an import's rows and dialogues, and upload scene pictures, to the shared link automatically
tasks.dod: A pending import is delivered once even across an app restart, a picture is uploaded after collection, and an expired link stops the retries.

tasks.title: Update the repo docs this design outdates and run the release checks
tasks.dod: The docs describe what shipped, and the device pass results are recorded against every spec §6 row.
